findings.evidence: Table 6-1, Decode row, "Resource tell" cell: "batch-1 single-device illustration only: high HBM util, low FLOP util (at the canonical point HBM util is ~21%, not saturated)". The same row's Verdict cell: "memory-bound by intensity (~1.0 FLOP/byte ≪ ridge ~295); weight-read bandwidth is not binding at the canonical point — 0.70 TB/s ÷ 3.35 TB/s = 20.9% achieved HBM util".
findings.issue: The diagnostic cell contradicts itself inside one cell: it names "high HBM util" as the telemetry tell for a bandwidth-bound decode, and then states that at the canonical operating point HBM utilization is ~21%, i.e. not high and not saturated. Ch 6's stated purpose is to let a reader "tell bandwidth-bound from compute-bound purely from the counters", so a tell that does not hold at the book's own canonical operating point is a defect in the diagnostic instruction, not just awkward phrasing.
findings.fix_instruction: Split the cell into two explicit cases: the single-device batch-1 illustration (tell: high HBM util, low FLOP util) and the canonical 8×H100 TP=8 operating point (tell: low-to-moderate HBM util (~21%), and the binding evidence is TP-collective/kernel/scheduling overhead plus KV-attention traffic, with MFU/queue-depth as the observable).

findings.evidence: In-figure label in Fig 6.2 reads "SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)" and "SLO-violating region (> 2 s)". The figure caption states the opposite convention: "the p95 TTFT ceiling (Table 4-2), not the 1.2 s design budget — a superset of TTFT violations". Ch 4 §4.3 makes the distinction explicit: "The two thresholds are not interchangeable: 1.2 s is the design budget, ≤ 2 s is the p95 ceiling the budget relaxes to, and any pass/fail judgement on a measured distribution is made against the p95 ceiling, not the budget."
findings.issue: Figure-vs-caption/labelling mismatch: the in-figure legend calls the 2 s line the "TTFT budget", which is the book's term for the 1.2 s design budget (TTFT budget 1.2 s, retrieval ~120 ms + prefill ~1.08 s). The caption itself flags the correct reading (p95 ceiling). A reader reading only the graphic will apply the wrong threshold name to the wrong line, and the same line is used in Ch 6's text as "the 2 s SLO" / "the p95 TTFT-ceiling line".
findings.fix_instruction: Change the in-figure label from "SLO 2 s (TTFT budget)" to "p95 TTFT ceiling 2 s (SLO)" (and, if both lines are wanted, add the 1.2 s design-budget line separately), matching the caption's terminology and Table 4-2's naming.
